problem: A manifest cannot include the digest of its own complete bytes in the same byte projection without recursion.

candidate_solution.projection_rule: Remove only the complete self_binding member from the top-level manifest object, then RFC8785-JCS canonicalize the remaining JSON value and SHA-256 hash those canonical bytes.

verification_algorithm: Parse JSON while rejecting duplicate object member names.
Require a top-level self_binding member with the exact supported domain/projection identifiers.
Create an in-memory copy of the top-level JSON value excluding only self_binding.
Verify the remaining value satisfies RFC 8785 / I-JSON canonicalization preconditions required by the implementation profile.
SHA-256 hash the canonical projection bytes.
Compare with self_binding.digest using the declared digest domain.
Fail closed on mismatch or unsupported projection/domain.
anti_confusion: self_binding digest is not the raw SHA-256 of the complete manifest file
raw-file SHA-256 may be recorded independently under SHA256_RAW_BYTES_V1
JCS digest and NEXUS_SORTED_JSON_V1 digest must never be compared as if they share a domain
changing any top-level member other than self_binding changes the projection digest
open_questions: Whether the binding projection should exclude only self_binding or use a detached envelope for broader ecosystem interoperability.
Whether stable adoption should use in-toto Statement subjects rather than custom manifest self-binding for some artifact classes.
